title: A word patch preserves an agreeing tape
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a set, let $c_t:\mathbb{Z}\to\operatorname{Option}(\Gamma)$ be a tape, let $c_p\in\mathbb{Z}$, and let $u$ be a finite word over $\Gamma$. Suppose that for every integer $p$ with $-1\le p\le |u|$, the tape content at $c_p+p$ equals the content of $u$ at offset $p$. Patching the tape with $u$ at $c_p$ leaves the entire tape unchanged.
